scope: Source/provenance and arithmetic over retained arrays only; no numerical kernels, build, Symbolica process or timing. Existing reviewed contraction loop and comparison helpers independently replayed against all stored rows. No package mutation or new algebra implementation.

provenance_review.compiler: GNU Fortran 15.2, same compiler and library hash; only CMakeLists differs between upstream/generated source
provenance_review.failed_diagnostic: retained KeyError IntegrationByParts with one partial row

source_identity_review.pinch0: qprime=q+p1; original q=qprime-p1. All 128 translated triangle inputs checked.
source_identity_review.normalization: Native [UV single, IR single, IR double, finite]; i*pi^2 normalization and finite subtraction (EulerGamma+ln(pi))*UV. No whole odd-rank sign. Scale setter receives mu squared.
source_identity_review.trace_caveat: Four-dimensional rank2/3 contracted traces differ from D-dimensional traces by +2 epsilon times covariant metric coefficients D_00 or sum p_i^nu D_00i. These coefficients have no UV/IR pole on this massive Euclidean N4 rank<=3 slice, so no finite correction. Covariant D_00 differs from the Cartesian time component. Rank4 and divergent bubble/triangle trace applications excluded.
source_identity_review.executed: Vector denominator differences, rank2 trace, four rank3 traces, time reflection and UV finiteness. Higher-moment denominator-difference extensions are documented but not claimed executed.

limitations: Only two rank0 COLI coordinates qualify; six rank1..3 COLI coordinates retain AccFlag=-1 despite numerical agreement. All eight DD coordinates retain ErrFlag=-10; null finite components are counted and remain failures.
No N4 timing/performance claim. BENCH single-call total_ns and elapsed correctness times are not benchmark measurements.
CLI executable is pinned; current CLI source inventory is contextual rather than a source-matched rebuild claim.
Referenced binaries/library remain external to the package, present and hash verified.
Earlier history and initial8 timing are path-only references in the package; this receipt binds their current hashes without claiming the package itself froze them.
The residual helper lacks explicit NaN guards; this audit enforced finite lhs, rhs, residual and normalized error for every actual identity slot. General malformed-data robustness is not qualified.
